title: Find Minimum Time to Finish All Jobs
summary: Given an integer array jobs, where jobs[i] represents the time required to complete the i-th job, you need to assign these jobs to k workers.
statement: Given an integer array jobs, where jobs[i] represents the time required to complete the i-th job, you need to assign these jobs to k workers. Each job must be assigned to exactly one worker. The goal is to minimize the maximum working time among all workers, where the working time for a worker is the sum of the times for all jobs assigned to that worker. Return the minimum possible maximum working time for any assignment.
constraints: Each job has a positive duration and must be assigned whole to one of k workers.
Workers operate simultaneously; minimize the maximum assigned workload.
hints: Large jobs constrain the makespan most, and workers with equal loads are symmetric.
Sort jobs descending and backtrack assignments while pruning repeated loads and branches already at the best bound.
At a full assignment minimize max(loads); undo each choice before trying the next worker.
The search enumerates one representative of every distinct assignment-load state, so the best complete maximum is globally optimal.
